name: Futamata Ren'ai - Yua & Kirame Mini After Story
original_name: フタマタ恋愛 結愛＆煌ミニアフターストーリー
source:
No more fumbling!?

After many twists and turns, the main character finally finds true love.
However, they won’t forgive me for their peaceful days… I have to become more lovey-dovey!

A true flirtatious after-story, depicting the aftermath of the girls who were annoyed by Futamata!

[Translated from[url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1186113/?gc=gc/] getchu[/url]]
